distribution: Compiled app-internal presentation; editable sources and source maps excluded

sources.adaptation: Presentation slots replace demo textarea/model/search/token-count state; utility CSS translated to application tokens.
Header/body/footer structure retained; actual owner decisions, preview and expiry stay in the host and remain visible.
File name, icon and trailing open action retained; real visibility and size replace demo metadata; no demo scroll/stream state.
Centered illustration/title/description/action hierarchy; decorative empty geometry replaces ghost data; actions are supplied by the host.
Inset search/body/footer structure and grouped results; existing production search, focus and navigation retained; demo command data and timers removed.
Detail-sheet title and close region with a compact identity icon; existing inspector visibility, Escape, focus return and content ownership retained.
Avatar/name/role hierarchy uses the authenticated user; existing real logout is a host slot; no demo navigation or workspace settings action.
Compact status arc and fact label; no synthetic timeline, elapsed clock, percent or local completion. Host controls active state from public phase, connectivity and page visibility.
Tool glyph/name/status row; no target arguments, fake duration, sample calls, timers or retry. Host preserves call/result correlation and audience filtering.
Avatar/title/meta/body/action hierarchy translated to project identity and real controls; demo stats/connect state removed.
Compact identity/content/status row becomes a real task link; supplier filters and sample spend removed.
Avatar/author/time/body and inset composer retained; real comment state/run references stay in host; fake reactions and thread mutations removed.
Grouped settings surface and labeled field hierarchy; native fieldsets and advanced disclosure replace demo preferences, saved-time and sticky save simulation.
Compact inbox header, icon/content/meta rows; only actionable server projection, real deep links and client category filters; no fake unread/archive/snooze.
Stable keyed semantic list item entry translated to CSS opacity/6px slide and capped stagger; demo timers, auto-add, reorder and Motion removed; keyboard/reduced motion immediate.
Fade/slide expansion variant adapted to interruptible inline grid disclosure; fullscreen image portal and scroll lock removed; host owns visibility/presence; hidden content inert.
Header/count and compact identity/cell hierarchy translated to a responsive member roster and section slots; fake order groups, density and pagination removed.
Icon/name/meta/body/action structure retained for real plugin catalog, installation and immutable Pack records; no sample connections, filters or simulated connect toggles.
Compact icon/title/description/trailing control row becomes a host-owned Agent selector and detail heading; demo switches/premium state removed.
Fleet identity/platform/status hierarchy reduced to real device facts and last-seen; no CPU/memory/disk/uptime simulations, filters or metrics timers.
